## Prepare the SOP
```{r}
SOP <- read.csv("../raw/IMPC_SOP_2026.csv")

#View(SOP)
# Update the SOP limits based on the supplied remarks and examples.
SOP[1,3] <- 12
SOP[1,4] <- 12
SOP[4,4] <- 26
SOP[10,4] <-20

write.csv(SOP, file="SOP_clean.csv",row.names = FALSE)
```
## Extract allowed values from SOP remarks
```{r}
SOP_clean <- read.csv("SOP_clean.csv")
#View(SOP_clean)

remarks <- as.character(SOP_clean$remarks)
extract_remarkslist <- function(remarks,field){
  if (grepl("Values are", remarks)){
    valid <- sub(".*Values are[:]?\\s*","",remarks)
# Extract allowed values from SOP remarks; mouse_life_stage uses semicolons and other fields use commas.
    if(field == "mouse_life_stage"){
      valids <- trimws(strsplit(valid, ";")[[1]])
    }else{
      valids <- trimws(strsplit(valid, ",")[[1]])
    }
    valids <- gsub("\\.\\s*$", "", valids)
    valids <- trimws(valids)
    return(valids)
  }else{
    return(NA)
  }
}

remark_list <- setNames(
  mapply(extract_remarkslist, SOP_clean$remarks, SOP_clean$dataField, SIMPLIFY = FALSE),
  SOP_clean$dataField
)
```
## Set input and output paths
```{r}
data <- list.files(path = "../raw/group6_data/group6_data/", pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
clean_directory <- "clean_data"
error_directory <- "clean_error"

if(!dir.exists(clean_directory)){
  dir.create(clean_directory, recursive = TRUE)
}
if(!dir.exists(error_directory)){
  dir.create(error_directory, recursive = TRUE)
}

valid_lacz <- remark_list[["lacz_*"]]
valid_strain_name <- remark_list[["strain_name"]]
valid_mouse_life_stage <-remark_list[["mouse_life_stage"]]
valid_hyphen_gene <- c("H2-M5", "H2-Q10", "Hbb-bh2", "Krtap17-1", "Pphln1-ps1")
```
## SOP validation function
```{r}
data_SOP <- function(df, SOP_clean, remark_list, valid_lacz) {
  fields <- as.character(df[, 1])
  values <- as.character(df[, 2])
  
  error_clean <- data.frame(
  file_name = character(),
  field = character(),
  error_value = character(),
  error_reason = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
  
  file_has_error <-FALSE
  current_gene_symbol <- if ("gene_symbol"%in%fields) {
    values[fields == "gene_symbol"][1]
  }else {
    NA
  }
  
  fields[fields == "parameter_stable_id"] <- "parameter_id"
  fields[fields == "p_value"] <- "pvalue"
  
# Check for blank field names and the expected number of fields.
  empty_field <- which(is.na(fields) | trimws(fields) == "")
  if (length(empty_field)>0){
    file_has_error <- TRUE
    error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
      file_name = "", field = "(empty)", error_value = values[empty_field[1]],error_reason = "missing field"
    ))
  }
  if(length(fields) < 20){
    file_has_error <- TRUE
    error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
      file_name = "", field = "(structure)", error_value = NA,error_reason = "total fields < 20"
    ))
  }
# Count the lacZ result fields by their shared field-name prefix.
  lacz_count <- length(grep("^lacz_", fields))
  if(lacz_count < 11){
    file_has_error <- TRUE
    error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
      file_name = "", field = "(structure)", error_value = NA,error_reason = "lacz fields < 11"
    ))
  }
  
  for (j in 1:nrow (SOP_clean)) {
    field <- SOP_clean$dataField[j]
    type <- SOP_clean$dataType[j]
    min <- as.numeric(SOP_clean$minValue[j])
    max <- as.numeric(SOP_clean$maxValue[j])
    
    if(field == "lacz_*"){
# Find each lacZ field so its value can be checked against the SOP list.
      lacz_fields <- grep("^lacz_", fields, value = TRUE)
      if(length(lacz_fields) == 0){
        file_has_error <- TRUE
        error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
          file_name =  "", field = field,error_value = NA, error_reason = "missing all lacz"
        ))
      }else{
        for ( lacz in lacz_fields){
          value <- values[fields == lacz][1]
          if (is.na(value)) next
          if (!(value %in% valid_lacz)){
           file_has_error <- TRUE
           error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
             file_name = "", field = lacz, error_value = value, error_reason = "not in remarklist"))
          }
        }
      }
    }else{
      if (!(field%in%fields)){
        file_has_error <- TRUE
        error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
          file_name = "", field=field,error_value = NA,error_reason = "missing field"
        ))
      }else{
        allvalue <- values[fields == field][1]
        if (field == "gene_symbol" &&(is.na(allvalue) || trimws(allvalue) == "")) {
  file_has_error <- TRUE
  error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
    file_name = "",field = field,error_value = allvalue,error_reason = "missing gene_symbol"
  ))
  next
}
        if (is.na(allvalue)) next
        if (type == "Float"){
          has_space <- (allvalue != trimws(allvalue))
          number_value <- as.numeric(allvalue)
          if (has_space){
            file_has_error <- TRUE
        error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
          file_name = "", field = field, error_value = allvalue,error_reason = "numeric value contains leading or trailing spaces"
        ))
          }
          else if (is.na(number_value)){
            file_has_error <- TRUE
            error_clean <-rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
          file_name = "", field=field,error_value = allvalue, error_reason = "not a valid number"
        ))
          }else if (!(number_value >= min & number_value <=max )){
            file_has_error <- TRUE
            error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
              file_name = "", field=field,error_value = allvalue,error_reason = "not in range"
        ))
          }
        }else if (type == "String"){
        if (field == "analysis_id"){
            valid_id <- grepl("^an[0-9]+$", allvalue)
            valid_len <- isTRUE(nchar(allvalue) >= min && nchar(allvalue) <= max)
            if (!valid_id||!valid_len){
               file_has_error <- TRUE 
               error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
              file_name="", field = field,error_value = allvalue, error_reason = "invalid analysis_id"))
            }
          }else if (field == "gene_accession_id"){
            valid_id <- grepl("^MGI:[0-9]+$", allvalue)
            valid_len <- isTRUE(nchar(allvalue) >= min && nchar(allvalue) <= max)
            if (!valid_id||!valid_len){
               file_has_error <- TRUE
               error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
              file_name="", field = field,error_value = allvalue, error_reason = "invalid gene_accession_id"))
            }
          }else if (field == "parameter_id"){
# Match the accepted parameter ID structures, including M-G-P IDs.
            valid_id <-
  grepl("^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*_[A-Z]{3}(_[0-9]{3}){2,3}$", allvalue) ||
  grepl("^ESLIM(_[0-9]{3}){3}$", allvalue) ||
  grepl("^M-G-P(_[0-9]{3}){3}$", allvalue)
            valid_len <- isTRUE(nchar(allvalue) >= min && nchar(allvalue) <= max)
            
            if (!valid_id || !valid_len ){
               file_has_error <- TRUE
               error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
              file_name="", field = field,error_value = allvalue, error_reason = "invalid parameter_id"))
            }
          }else if (field == "strain_name" || field == "mouse_life_stage"){
            valid_list <- remark_list[[field]]
            if (!(allvalue %in% valid_list)) {
              file_has_error <- TRUE
              error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
                file_name = "", field = field,error_value = allvalue,error_reason = "value not in remark_list"
              ))
            }
          }else if (field == "allele_symbol") {

  if (is.na(current_gene_symbol) || !nzchar(current_gene_symbol)) {
    file_has_error <- TRUE
    error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
      file_name = "",field = field,error_value = allvalue,error_reason = "not match gene_symbol"
    ))

  } else {
    valid_symbol <- !is.na(allvalue) &&grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9<>().-]+$", allvalue)
    valid_len <- !is.na(allvalue) &&isTRUE(nchar(allvalue) >= min && nchar(allvalue) <= max)
    open_match <- !is.na(allvalue) &&startsWith(allvalue, paste0(current_gene_symbol, "<"))
    valid_format <- FALSE

    if (open_match) {
  allele_part <- substring(allvalue, nchar(current_gene_symbol) + 2L)
# The allele body may use targeted-mutation (tm) or gene-trap (Gt) notation.
  targeted_allele_format <- grepl("^(tm[0-9]+[a-z]?(\\.[0-9]+)?(\\([A-Z0-9]+\\))?[A-Z][a-z0-9]*)>$",allele_part)
  gene_trap_format <- grepl("^Gt\\([A-Z0-9]+\\)[A-Z][a-z0-9]*>$",allele_part)
  valid_format <- targeted_allele_format || gene_trap_format
}

    if (!valid_len || !valid_symbol) {
      file_has_error <- TRUE
      error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
        file_name = "",field = field,error_value = allvalue,error_reason = "not in range"))
    }

    if (!open_match || !valid_format) {
      file_has_error <- TRUE
      error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
        file_name = "",field = field,error_value = allvalue,error_reason = "not meet the remark"
      ))
    }
  }
} else if (field == "gene_symbol"){
  if (grepl("^[0-9]", allvalue)) {
  file_has_error <- TRUE
  error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
    file_name = "", field = field, error_value = allvalue,error_reason = "numeric-leading gene_symbol: round3 review"
  ))
} else {
# Check the gene-symbol case pattern or an approved symbol that contains hyphens.
  valid_symbol <- grepl("^[A-Z][a-z0-9]*([0-9][A-Z][a-z][a-z0-9]*)?$",allvalue) || allvalue %in% valid_hyphen_gene
  valid_len <- isTRUE(nchar(allvalue) >= min && nchar(allvalue) <= max)
            if(!valid_symbol||!valid_len){
              file_has_error <- TRUE
              error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
              file_name="", field = field,error_value = allvalue, error_reason = "invalid gene_symbol"))
            }
       }
  }else{
    len <- nchar(allvalue)
    if(is.na(len) || len < min || len > max){
      file_has_error <- TRUE
      error_clean <- rbind(error_clean, data.frame(
        file_name = "", field = field,error_value = allvalue,error_reason = "length not in range"
      ))
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
  return(list(file_has_error = file_has_error, error_clean = error_clean))
    }
```
## Round 1: validate raw files
```{r}
error_clean_1 <- data.frame(
  file_name = character(),
  field = character(),
  error_value = character(),
  error_reason = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in data){
  theData <- read.csv(i, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = FALSE)
  result <- data_SOP(theData,SOP_clean, remark_list, valid_lacz)
  
  if (!result$file_has_error) {
  file.copy(i, file.path(clean_directory, basename(i)), overwrite = TRUE)
} else {
  result$error_clean$file_name <- basename(i)
  error_clean_1 <- rbind(error_clean_1, result$error_clean)
  file.copy(i, file.path(error_directory, basename(i)), overwrite = TRUE)
}
}


write.csv(error_clean_1,"error_summary_1.csv",row.names = FALSE)

#View(error_clean_1)
```

## Round 2: clean formatting errors
```{r}
error_clean_2 <- data.frame(
  file_name = character(),
  field = character(),
  error_value = character(),
  error_reason = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

error_files <- list.files(error_directory, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

if (length(error_files) == 0) {
  cat("no error files")
} else {
  
  for (file in error_files) {
    filename <- basename(file)
    
    error_1 <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = FALSE)
    fields <- as.character(error_1[,1])
    values <- as.character(error_1[,2])
# Use the SOP field names for cleaning while keeping the source labels intact.
    fields[fields == "parameter_stable_id"] <- "parameter_id"
    fields[fields == "p_value"] <- "pvalue"
    
    current_gene_symbol <- if ("gene_symbol" %in% fields) values[fields == "gene_symbol"][1] else NA
# Fill a missing gene symbol from the allele symbol prefix when available.
    if ((is.na(current_gene_symbol) || !nzchar(trimws(current_gene_symbol))) &&"allele_symbol" %in% fields) {
  allele_value <- values[fields == "allele_symbol"][1]
  
  if (!is.na(allele_value) && grepl("<", allele_value, fixed = TRUE)) {
    current_gene_symbol <- sub("<.*$", "", trimws(allele_value))
    values[fields == "gene_symbol"] <- current_gene_symbol
  }
}
    
    for (k in 1:length(fields)) {
      field <- fields[k]
      value <- values[k]
      if (is.na(value)) next
      
    if (field == "pvalue"){
      clean_value <- trimws(value)
      num <- as.numeric(clean_value)

        if (!is.na(num) && (num < 0 || num > 1)) {
          values[k] <- NA_character_
        }else {
      values[k] <- clean_value
    } 
      }else if (field == "analysis_id"){
# Remove accidental trailing backslashes from the analysis identifier.
        values[k] <- gsub("\\\\+\\s*$", "", value)
      }else if (field == "gene_accession_id"){
# Keep the MGI accession and discard any trailing accidental characters.
        values[k] <- sub("^(MGI:[0-9]+).*$", "\\1", value)
      }else if (grepl("^lacz_", field) ) {
# Remove unexpected punctuation, then use the matching SOP value when available.
        clean_value <- trimws(gsub("[^A-Za-z ]", "", value))
        match_idx <- which(tolower(valid_lacz) == tolower(clean_value))
        if (length(match_idx) > 0) {
          values[k] <- valid_lacz[match_idx[1]]
        } else {
          values[k] <- clean_value
        }
      } else if(field == "strain_name"){
# Remove characters outside the expected strain-name alphabet before matching.
        clean_value <- trimws(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9/<>;\\-]", "", value))
        match_idx <- which(tolower(valid_strain_name) == tolower(clean_value))
        if (length(match_idx) > 0) {
          values[k] <- valid_strain_name[match_idx[1]]
        }
        }else if(field == "mouse_life_stage"){
# Keep letters, digits, spaces, and periods, then normalize repeated periods.
        clean_value <- trimws(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9\\. ]", "", value))
# Keep periods as age separators when the stage contains numbers; remove them from stages without numbers.
        if(grepl("[0-9]", clean_value)){
          clean_value <- gsub("^([A-Za-z])\\.+", "\\1", clean_value)
          clean_value <- gsub("\\.+", ".", clean_value)
          clean_value <- gsub("\\.$", "", clean_value)
        }else{clean_value <- gsub("\\.", "", clean_value)
        }
        match_idx <- which(tolower(valid_mouse_life_stage) == tolower(clean_value))
        if (length(match_idx) > 0) {
          values[k] <- valid_mouse_life_stage[match_idx[1]]
        }
        } else if (field == "gene_symbol") {
# Clean the symbol, preserve approved hyphens, and normalize all-capital names.
  if (!is.na(current_gene_symbol)) {
    current_gene_symbol <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9-]", "", current_gene_symbol)
    hyphen_idx <- match(tolower(current_gene_symbol), tolower(valid_hyphen_gene))

    if (is.na(hyphen_idx)) {
      current_gene_symbol <- gsub("-", "", current_gene_symbol, fixed = TRUE)
    } else {
      current_gene_symbol <- valid_hyphen_gene[hyphen_idx]
    }

    current_gene_symbol <- paste0(
      toupper(substring(current_gene_symbol, 1, 1)),
      substring(current_gene_symbol, 2)
    )
    values[fields == "gene_symbol"] <- current_gene_symbol
  }
} else if (field == "allele_symbol") {
# Keep allele punctuation, parentheses, and angle brackets while removing other symbols.
  allele_symbol <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9<>().-]", "", value)
# Add the current gene symbol when a tm allele value is missing its gene prefix.
  if (!is.na(current_gene_symbol) && !grepl("<", allele_symbol, fixed = TRUE) && grepl("^tm[0-9].*>$", allele_symbol, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    allele_symbol <- paste0(current_gene_symbol, "<", allele_symbol)
  }

  if (grepl("^[^<>]*<[^<>]+>$", allele_symbol)) {
    gene_part   <- sub("<.*$", "", allele_symbol)
    allele_part <- sub("^[^<]*<", "", allele_symbol)
    allele_part <- sub(">$", "", allele_part)
# Normalize accidental punctuation around the allele type, project, and lab code.
    allele_clean <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9.]", "", allele_part)
    allele_clean <- gsub("\\.{2,}", ".", allele_clean)
    allele_clean <- gsub("\\.([A-Za-z])", "\\1", allele_clean)
    allele_clean <- sub("^tm\\.", "tm", allele_clean, ignore.case = TRUE)
    allele_clean <- sub("\\.$", "", allele_clean)
# Split the recognized tm allele into its type, project, and lab code.
    parts <- regmatches(allele_clean, regexec(
      "^(tm[0-9]+[a-z]?(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)(KOMP|EUCOMM)?(WTSI|VLCG|HMGU|MBP|MFGC|NARL|TIGM|J)$",
      allele_clean, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    ))[[1]]

    if (length(parts) == 4) {
      project <- if (nzchar(parts[3])) paste0("(", toupper(parts[3]), ")") else ""
      lab     <- paste0(toupper(substr(parts[4], 1, 1)), tolower(substring(parts[4], 2)))
      allele_part <- paste0(tolower(parts[2]), project, lab)
    }

    if (!is.na(current_gene_symbol) && nzchar(current_gene_symbol)) {
      gene_part <- current_gene_symbol
    }
    values[k] <- paste0(gene_part, "<", allele_part, ">")
  } else {
    values[k] <- allele_symbol
  }
  
} else if (field == "parameter_id") {
# Standardize the ID characters and repair split numeric groups.
  clean_value <- toupper(value)
  clean_value <- gsub("[^A-Z0-9_]", "", clean_value)
  clean_value <- gsub("_{2,}", "_", clean_value)
  clean_value <- gsub("^_+|_+$", "", clean_value)

  repeat {
    repaired <- gsub("_([0-9]{1,2})_([0-9]{1,2})(?=_|$)", "_\\1\\2", clean_value, perl = TRUE)
    if (identical(repaired, clean_value)) break
    clean_value <- repaired
  }
  
  clean_value <- sub("^([A-Z]{1,3})_([A-Z]{1,3})_([A-Z]{3})_", "\\1\\2_\\3_", clean_value)
  clean_value <- sub("^([A-Z]+)_([A-Z]{1,2})_([A-Z]{1,2})_", "\\1_\\2\\3_", clean_value)
  clean_value <- sub("^ESL_IM_", "ESLIM_", clean_value)
# Restore M-G-P hyphens only for IDs followed by three groups of three digits; other suffixes do not match this rule.
  clean_value <- sub("^M_?G_?P_([0-9]{3}_[0-9]{3}_[0-9]{3})$", "M-G-P_\\1", clean_value)

  values[k] <- clean_value
}
}
# Save the cleaned values, then recheck the whole file against the SOP.
   error_1[, 2] <- values
   result_2 <- data_SOP(error_1, SOP_clean, remark_list, valid_lacz)
   if (!result_2$file_has_error){
     write.table(error_1, file.path(clean_directory, filename),sep = ",", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE,quote = TRUE, na = "NA")
     file.remove(file)
}else{file.remove(file)
  write.table(error_1, file.path(error_directory, filename),sep = ",", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE, na = "NA")
  result_2$error_clean$file_name <- filename
  error_clean_2 <- rbind(error_clean_2, result_2$error_clean)
}
  }
}
write.csv(error_clean_2, "error_summary_2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
#View(error_clean_2)
```

## Round 3: review gene symbols and remaining errors
```{r}
error_clean_3 <- data.frame(
  file_name = character(),
  field = character(),
  error_value = character(),
  error_reason = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

error_files <- list.files(error_directory, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

if(length(error_files) == 0){
  cat("no error files")
}

round3_valid_gene <- c(
  "AB124611", "AI467606", "AI837181", "AU021092", "BC048562",
  "A830005F24Rik", "D130043K22Rik","D630023F18Rik", "D930020B18Rik"
)
round3_valid_gene <- c(
  round3_valid_gene,
  "1700029H14Rik","2510002D24Rik","4921509C19Rik"
)

for (file in error_files) {
  filename <- basename(file)
    error_2 <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = FALSE)
    
    idx <- which(error_2[, 1] == "gene_symbol")
if (length(idx) == 1) {
  old <- as.character(error_2[idx, 2])
# Normalize all-capital symbols except the approved list and H2 names excluded from this rule.
  if (!is.na(old) &&grepl("^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*$", old) &&!(old %in% round3_valid_gene) &&!grepl("^H2[MQ][0-9]+$", old)) {
    new <- paste0(substr(old, 1, 1), tolower(substring(old, 2)))
    error_2[idx, 2] <- new
    allele_idx <- which(error_2[, 1] == "allele_symbol")
    if (length(allele_idx) == 1 &&!is.na(error_2[allele_idx, 2]) &&startsWith(error_2[allele_idx, 2], paste0(old, "<"))) {
      error_2[allele_idx, 2] <- paste0(new, substring(error_2[allele_idx, 2], nchar(old) + 1))
    }
  }
}
    result_3 <- data_SOP(error_2, SOP_clean, remark_list, valid_lacz)
# Exempt only approved gene-symbol errors; other fields in the file still need to pass.
    rik_ok <- grepl("^([0-9]{7}|[A-Z][0-9]{6})[A-Z][0-9]{2}Rik$",result_3$error_clean$error_value)

ignore <- result_3$error_clean$field == "gene_symbol" &(result_3$error_clean$error_value %in% round3_valid_gene | rik_ok)
result_3$error_clean <- result_3$error_clean[!ignore, , drop = FALSE]
result_3$file_has_error <- nrow(result_3$error_clean) > 0
    
if (!result_3$file_has_error){
  write.table(error_2, file.path(clean_directory, filename), sep = ",", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE, na = "NA")
      file.remove(file)
}else {
  write.table(error_2, file, sep = ",",row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE,quote = TRUE, na = "NA")
  result_3$error_clean$file_name <- filename
  error_clean_3 <- rbind(error_clean_3, result_3$error_clean)
}
}

write.csv(error_clean_3, "error_summary_3.csv", row.names = FALSE)
#View(error_clean_3)
```

## Recheck Round 4 files against the SOP
```{r}
error_clean_4 <- data.frame(
  file_name = character(),
  field = character(),
  error_value = character(),
  error_reason = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

error_files <- list.files(
  error_directory, pattern = "*.csv",
  full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE
)

for (file in error_files) {
  filename <- basename(file)
  error_3 <- read.csv(file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  result_4 <- data_SOP(error_3, SOP_clean, remark_list, valid_lacz)
# Apply the same field-specific gene-symbol exemptions used in Round 3.
  ignore <- result_4$error_clean$field == "gene_symbol" &result_4$error_clean$error_value %in% round3_valid_gene
  result_4$error_clean <- result_4$error_clean[!ignore, , drop = FALSE]
  result_4$file_has_error <- nrow(result_4$error_clean) > 0

  if (!result_4$file_has_error) {
    write.table(
      error_3, file.path(clean_directory, filename),
      sep = ",", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE,
      quote = TRUE, na = "NA"
    )
    file.remove(file)
  } else {
    result_4$error_clean$file_name <- filename
    error_clean_4 <- rbind(error_clean_4, result_4$error_clean)
  }
}

write.csv(error_clean_4, "error_summary_4.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Combine cleaned files
```{r}
library(tidyr)

clean_files <- list.files("clean_data", pattern = "*.csv$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
combinedcleanData <- data.frame()

for (file in clean_files) {
  #cat("Processing:", basename(file), "\n")
  
  cleandata <- read.csv(file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(cleandata) <- c("field", "value")

tcleanData <- cleandata %>%
pivot_wider(
    names_from = field,       
    values_from = value,
    values_fn = first
  )
combinedcleanData <- bind_rows(combinedcleanData, tcleanData)
}

write.csv(combinedcleanData, "combined_clean_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
#View(combinedcleanData)
```

## Remove exact duplicates and combine matching analysis IDs
```{r}
library(tidyr)

combined_clean_data <- read.csv("combined_clean_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

sum(duplicated(combined_clean_data$analysis_id))
sum(duplicated(combined_clean_data))
# Find IDs that still occur more than once after removing identical full rows.
df_unique <- combined_clean_data %>% distinct()
sum(duplicated(df_unique$analysis_id))
sum(duplicated(df_unique))

dup_ids <- df_unique %>%
  count(analysis_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  pull(analysis_id)

dup_rows <- df_unique %>%
  filter(analysis_id %in% dup_ids) %>%
  arrange(analysis_id)
# Merge complementary values and mark differing values as conflicts.
merged_dups <- dup_rows[0, , drop = FALSE]
merged_dups[] <- lapply(merged_dups, as.character)
# Collect all rows that share the current duplicated analysis ID.
for (current_id in dup_ids) {
  selected_rows <- dup_rows[
    dup_rows$analysis_id == current_id,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  merged_row <- selected_rows[1, , drop = FALSE]
  merged_row[] <- lapply(merged_row, as.character)

  for (column_name in names(selected_rows)) {
    if (column_name != "analysis_id") {
      column_values <- selected_rows[[column_name]]
      column_values <- column_values[!is.na(column_values)]
      column_values <- as.character(column_values)
      column_values <- column_values[column_values != ""]
      column_values <- unique(column_values)

      if (length(column_values) == 0) {
        merged_row[[column_name]] <- NA_character_
      } else if (length(column_values) == 1) {
        merged_row[[column_name]] <- column_values[1]
      } else {
        merged_row[[column_name]] <- paste(column_values, collapse = " | ")
      }
    }
  }

  merged_dups <- rbind(merged_dups, merged_row)
}
# Identify IDs whose duplicate records contain conflicting values.
conflict_rows <- merged_dups[0, , drop = FALSE]
perfectly_merged <- merged_dups[0, , drop = FALSE]

for (i in 1:nrow(merged_dups)) {
  has_conflict <- FALSE
  for (column_name in names(merged_dups)) {
    if (column_name != "analysis_id" &&grepl(" \\| ", merged_dups[i, column_name])) {
      has_conflict <- TRUE
    }
  }
  if (has_conflict) {
    conflict_rows <- rbind(conflict_rows, merged_dups[i, , drop = FALSE])
  } else {
    perfectly_merged <- rbind(perfectly_merged, merged_dups[i, , drop = FALSE])
  }
}
# Keep rows with unique analysis IDs and convert their columns to character
# so they match the types in perfectly_merged before binding.
clean_rows <- df_unique %>%filter(!(analysis_id %in% dup_ids))
clean_rows[] <- lapply(clean_rows, as.character)

final_clean_data <- clean_rows %>%bind_rows(perfectly_merged)

write.csv(final_clean_data, "final_clean_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
if (nrow(conflict_rows) > 0) {
  write.csv(conflict_rows, "conflict_manual_check.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Warning: ", nrow(conflict_rows),
      " conflicting analysis IDs found. See conflict_manual_check.csv.\n",
      sep = "")
} else {
  cat("No conflicts found.\n")
}
cat("Final data rows: ", nrow(final_clean_data), "\n", sep = "")
```

## Check final data counts and SOP validity
```{r}
# Compare raw, clean, error, combined, and final record counts.
raw_n    <- length(list.files("../raw/group6_data/group6_data", pattern = "*.csv"))
clean_n  <- length(list.files("clean_data", pattern = "*.csv"))
error_n  <- length(list.files("clean_error", pattern = "*.csv"))

combined_check <- read.csv("combined_clean_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
final_check    <- read.csv("final_clean_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

source_ok   <- raw_n == clean_n + error_n
combined_ok <- nrow(combined_check) == clean_n

conflict_ids <- conflict_rows$analysis_id
expected_final_ids <- setdiff(unique(combined_check$analysis_id), conflict_ids)
final_ok <- !anyNA(final_check$analysis_id) && 
            !any(final_check$analysis_id == "") && 
            anyDuplicated(final_check$analysis_id) == 0 && 
            nrow(final_check) == length(expected_final_ids) && 
            setequal(final_check$analysis_id, expected_final_ids)

final_errors <- data.frame(file_name=character(), field=character(), error_value=character(), error_reason=character())

for (i in seq_len(nrow(final_check))) {
# Keep missing values as NA, not the text "NA", during SOP validation.
  row_values <- unlist(final_check[i, , drop = FALSE], use.names = FALSE)
  row_long <- data.frame(
  field = names(final_check),
  value = as.character(row_values),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
errors <- data_SOP(row_long, SOP_clean, remark_list, valid_lacz)$error_clean
  
  if (nrow(errors) > 0) {
# Exempt only approved gene_symbol errors; errors in other fields still need to pass validation.
    rik_ok   <- grepl("^([0-9]{7}|[A-Z][0-9]{6})[A-Z][0-9]{2}Rik$", errors$error_value)
    approved <- errors$field == "gene_symbol" & (errors$error_value %in% round3_valid_gene | rik_ok)
    errors   <- errors[!approved, , drop = FALSE]
    
    if (nrow(errors) > 0) {
      errors$file_name <- final_check$analysis_id[i]
      final_errors <- rbind(final_errors, errors)
    }
  }
  if (i %% 2000L == 0L) message("Validated ", i, "/", nrow(final_check))
}

cat(sprintf("raw: %d | clean: %d | error: %d\n", raw_n, clean_n, error_n))
cat(sprintf("combined: %d | final: %d | conflict IDs: %d\n", nrow(combined_check), nrow(final_check), length(conflict_ids)))
cat(sprintf("source_ok: %s | combined_ok: %s | final_ok: %s\n", source_ok, combined_ok, final_ok))
cat("error number in SOP:", nrow(final_errors), "\n")

if (nrow(final_errors) > 0) {
  print(head(final_errors, 30))
  print(table(final_errors$field, final_errors$error_reason))
} else if (source_ok && combined_ok && final_ok) {
  cat("sucess\n")
}
```
